faq.q1: How do I report inappropriate content?
faq.a1: Fill in the form on /content-moderation or email support@nailfolio.app. Every report is reviewed by a human within 48 hours of receipt.
faq.a2: Every report is read by a person within 48 hours of arrival. The reporter stays anonymous; your details are never shared with the author of the content.
faq.q3: How do I appeal a moderation decision?

faq.q4: Does Nailfolio publish a DSA report?

faq.a0: Nailfolio is an app for nail stylists and their clients. It includes a work gallery with filters, QR connections, Inspiration Sessions and Messages. Paid plans also give stylists access to client visit history. The app works in a phone browser.
faq.q1: How does Nailfolio differ from an Instagram gallery?
faq.a1: In Nailfolio, clients browse your work using color, style and length filters. Once connected, they can select photos and share an Inspiration Session with notes. Paid plans also include visit history.
faq.a2: Yes. You sign up without a card and start on the Free plan: 5 gallery photos, a QR code and basic filters, free forever. faq.q3: What does the client get after scanning the QR code?
faq.a3: After signing in, the client sends a connection request. You confirm it with one tap, so you control access to your full gallery with filters for color, style and length. Once confirmed, the client browses your work, can like designs and send you an inspiration session before the visit.
faq.q4: What about my photos: who owns them?
faq.a4: You retain the rights to your photos. Nailfolio does not sell them or use them in ads. The Nailfolio database is hosted in the European Union. You can deactivate your account and restore it within 90 days.
faq.q5: How do I set up a portfolio?
faq.a5: Create an account, add photos and tag color, style and length. Then share your QR code with the client and approve their connection request.

contactAccessLog.content:
Every instance of a paired Stylist viewing a Client's contact data is recorded in the ContactAccessLog system.

Recorded information: Stylist identifier, Client identifier, date and time of access, type of data viewed.

Purpose: ensuring accountability in accordance with Art. 5(2) GDPR. Clients have the right to obtain information about who accessed their contact data and when.

cookies.content:
User sessions are managed via HTTP headers (header-based authentication), not traditional cookies. This is due to the app architecture running as a WebView in mobile applications.

Browser localStorage is used solely to store user interface preferences (e.g., selected color theme, language).

We use Google Tag Manager to manage and load our analytics scripts. We run analytics tools (PostHog, as well as Google Analytics 4 loaded via Google Tag Manager and Microsoft Clarity) only after you give consent in the cookie banner (details in the data sharing section). We do not use advertising cookies and do not share data with advertising companies.
cookies.title: 12. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

dataCollection.content:
We collect the following personal data:

Data provided during registration: email address (required), name or display name (required for Stylists), phone number (optional), city (required for Stylists).

Data optionally provided in the profile: business or salon name, address (street, postal code, country), website, booking link, Instagram link.

Technical data collected automatically: IP address, browser type (user agent), device type, session data (token, expiry time).

Nail art photos: uploaded by Stylists to their gallery. Photos should not contain faces or identifying information, see section 5.

Client contact data (optional): phone number and contact email visible only to paired Stylists.

In-app messages: the content of correspondence between a paired Stylist and Client in Messages (one thread per pair), and the content of support requests to Nailfolio. Using Messages is optional. Messages are included in the right to data portability (GDPR Art. 20).

VAT invoice details (optional, only at checkout): company name, address and tax ID (NIP). We store them only with Stripe, not in the Nailfolio database.
dataCollection.title: 2. What Data We Collect
dataCollection.callout: We only collect data essential to running Nailfolio. We never sell it or share it with advertising companies.

dataRetention.content:
General principle: we retain data no longer than necessary for the purposes of processing and for the periods required by law.

Active account data: retained for the entire duration of service use.

Data after account closure: for 90 days the account remains restorable (recovery) by logging back in. After 90 days the account is permanently closed and access expires. You may request data erasure at any time (Art. 17 GDPR), which we carry out subject to legal obligations (e.g. the obligation to retain billing data).

Billing data: retained for the period required by tax law (5 years from the end of the year in which the transaction occurred).

Session Share data: automatically deleted after 7 days.

Event log: retained in accordance with the Controller's retention policy (up to 12 months).

In-app messages and support requests: retained until the account is deleted, subject to the 90-day recovery window.

VAT invoice details: only with Stripe, in line with tax requirements (see billing data above).
dataRetention.title: 10. Data Retention

dataSharing.content:
Your data may be shared with the following data processors:

Stripe (payment processor, USA, EU-US DPF): email address and data necessary for payment processing. Stripe acts as an independent data controller, see Stripe's privacy policy for details.

Resend (email delivery, primary provider, USA, EU-US DPF): email address for delivering transactional messages and notifications.

Mailgun (email delivery, fallback provider, USA, EU-US DPF): email address for delivering messages when delivery via the primary provider fails.

Cloudinary (image hosting, USA, EU-US DPF): photos uploaded to gallery for storage and optimization.

Neon (database, USA, EU-US DPF): account, gallery, and activity data for service delivery.

Render (application hosting, USA, EU-US DPF): data processed on servers for service delivery.

Cloudflare (CDN and protection, USA, EU-US DPF): technical connection data for attack protection and content delivery optimization.

Google Tag Manager (tag management, USA, EU-US DPF): managing and loading analytics scripts (including Google Analytics 4). Loaded only if you consent via the cookie banner.

Google Analytics 4 (web analytics, loaded via Google Tag Manager, USA, EU-US DPF): anonymized IP address, page views, and usage events for product improvement. Only if you consent via the cookie banner.

Microsoft Clarity (UX analytics, USA, EU-US DPF): anonymized session recordings, heatmaps, and click data for interface improvement. Only if you consent via the cookie banner.

PostHog (product analytics, USA; data stored in the EU (Frankfurt), under Standard Contractual Clauses, SCC): usage events, heatmaps, and session recordings with form fields masked and sensitive URL parameters redacted, for product improvement. Only if you consent via the cookie banner.

We do not sell your personal data. We do not share data with advertising companies. We do not profile users for marketing purposes.

Data may be disclosed to law enforcement or courts pursuant to applicable law.

legalBasis.content:
We process data on the following legal bases (Art. 6(1) GDPR):

Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)): processing necessary to provide the service, registration, gallery management, uploading and displaying photos, QR connections with clients, Messages, support requests, payments.

Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): providing optional contact and profile data, cookie/analytics consents (PostHog, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity), and marketing/newsletter consents.

Legitimate interest of the Controller (Art. 6(1)(f)): Platform security, abuse prevention, internal analytics, enforcement of claims.

Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): retention of billing data in accordance with tax regulations.
legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing

photoRules.content:
Photos uploaded to the gallery should depict nail art exclusively. It is prohibited to upload photos containing faces, identity documents, or other identifying information.

Nail art photos do NOT constitute biometric data within the meaning of Art. 9 GDPR. We do not process photos for the purpose of identifying individuals.

The copyright owner of the photos is the Stylist who uploaded them. The Controller processes photos solely to display them in Nailfolio in accordance with the license granted in the Terms of Service.

Photos are stored with the provider Cloudinary (USA) on the basis of the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (EU-US DPF) adequacy decision; see Section 8 for details. After you close your account, photos remain available throughout the 90-day account recovery period. You may request permanent erasure of your photos at any time (Art. 17 GDPR).
photoRules.title: 5. Photos: Special Rules

processingPurposes.content:
We process your data for the following purposes:

Service delivery: account registration, authentication (Google, magic link), gallery management, QR pairing, Session Share, Staff Accounts, Messages between a paired Stylist and Client, support requests.

Communication: system notifications (e.g. session expiry, changes to the terms), transactional emails (registration confirmation, plan changes, trial end reminder, a new message in Messages).

Security: session monitoring, abuse detection, logging access to contact data (ContactAccessLog), protection against unauthorized access.

Internal analytics: anonymous usage statistics (number of accounts, activity, plan distribution). We do not profile users for advertising purposes.
processingPurposes.title: 3. Processing Purposes

qrPairing.content:
During QR pairing, the following data is exchanged: the Stylist account identifier, the Client account identifier, and the pairing date.

After pairing, the Client gains access to: the Stylist's photo gallery, display name, city, and contact details (if the Stylist provided them).

The Stylist gains access to: the Client's name and contact details (if the Client provided them in their profile). Every time a Stylist accesses a Client's contact data is recorded in the ContactAccessLog system.

The Client can revoke pairing in the app settings, which immediately cuts off the Stylist's access to their data.
qrPairing.title: 6. QR and Pairing, Data Exchange

sessionShare.content:
The Session Share feature lets a client share selected gallery photos directly with a stylist. The client picks a stylist from her list of paired stylists and sends the selected photos from her device.

Shared photos are available in the Stylist's Session Clipboard for 7 days from the moment of sharing.

After 7 days, the sharing data is automatically removed from the active view. The system retains only an audit record of the sharing event (without photo content) in the event log.
sessionShare.title: 7. Session Share, Temporary Data

userRights.content:
Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:

Right of access (Art. 15): you may obtain information about what personal data we process.

Right to rectification (Art. 16): you may request correction of inaccurate data.

Right to erasure (Art. 17): you may request data erasure at any time by contacting the Controller (privacy@nailfolio.app). We carry it out subject to legal obligations. Closing your account in the app settings is a separate feature: for 90 days the account remains restorable, and after that period it is permanently closed.

Right to data portability (Art. 20): you may request a copy of your data in a machine-readable format.

Right to object (Art. 21): you may object to processing based on legitimate interest.

Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18): you may request restriction of processing in certain situations.

Right to withdraw consent: you may withdraw your consent to data processing at any time. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.

Right to lodge a complaint: you have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO), ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, Poland, www.uodo.gov.pl.
userRights.title: 11. Your Rights

galleryRules.content:
The gallery is intended solely for displaying nail design photos. It is prohibited to upload photos containing: faces of people, identity documents, offensive or illegal content, or content unrelated to nail design.

The Stylist tags each photo with colors (1-3), style traits (at least 1), and nail length (short, medium, long, XL). Tags let clients filter the gallery.

Gallery photo limits depend on the pricing plan: Free plan, up to 5 photos, Pro plan and higher, unlimited. Once the limit is reached, the Stylist cannot add new photos without deleting older ones or moving to a higher plan.

The Stylist may pin selected photos to the top of the gallery (pinned). The number of pinned photos depends on the plan: Free plan up to 3, Pro plan up to 10, Pro Marka plan up to 15, Studio plan up to 30, Scale plan up to 50. Pinned photos are visible on the Stylist's public profile and appear first in the gallery.

Colors and style traits are defined globally by the Platform administrator, the Stylist cannot add her own tags.

plansPayments.content:
Clients use the Platform free of charge. Pricing plans apply only to Stylist accounts.

Available plans: Free (free, up to 5 photos, up to 2 paired clients), Pro (paid, unlimited photos and clients), Pro Marka (paid, expanded pinned photo and public profile limits, no staff accounts), Studio (paid, like Pro Marka plus the ability to create staff accounts), Scale (custom, for large salons).

Payments are handled by the external provider Stripe. The Platform does not store payment card data. Subscription management (changing plans, cancellation, invoices) is done through the Stripe customer portal.

A 30-day free trial is available for the Pro, Pro Marka, and Studio plans. Starting the trial requires entering a payment card in Stripe. When the trial ends, the subscription automatically moves to the chosen paid plan unless the user cancels during the trial period.

Moving to a higher plan takes effect immediately. Moving to a lower plan takes effect at the start of the next billing period. After a subscription is canceled, the account stays active until the end of the paid period.
plansPayments.title: 6. Plans and Payments

qrPairing.content:
A QR Connection gives a Client access to a Stylist's full gallery. Every Stylist has a permanent QR code in the app that leads to her public profile. The code can be printed, shown on a phone screen or shared as a link.

The Client scans the code, signs in to her account and sends a connection request. The request alone does not give access to the full gallery. The Stylist can accept or decline the request, and the Client can cancel it until it has been decided. Once the request is accepted, a permanent connection is created between the Stylist and Client accounts, and the Client gains access to the full gallery, filters, and the ability to save favorite designs.

A Client can be connected with at most 3 Stylists at the same time. Once the limit is reached, the Client must end one of the connections to add a new one.

Connected Client limits for Stylists depend on the plan: Free plan, up to 2 clients, Pro plan and above, unlimited.

The Stylist can end the connection with a Client at any time. In such case, the Client loses access to the full gallery, open inspiration sessions are closed, and her favorite designs from that gallery are deleted, except designs pinned on the Stylist's public profile.
qrPairing.title: 4. QR Connection

registration.content:
Using the Platform requires being at least 16 years old. People under 16 may not register an account on the Platform on their own. By registering an account, the user confirms that they are at least 16 years old (Art. 8 GDPR).

Registration on the Platform is done with a Google account or an email address (magic link). No password is required.

During the first steps, the user chooses their role: Stylist or Client. The chosen account type is fixed and cannot be changed, but the user can activate the second account type in settings (the dual-account architecture described below).

A single user may hold both a Stylist account and a Client account at the same time (dual-account architecture). The second account type can be activated in account settings. Switching between roles is done with a toggle in the app menu.

During the first steps, the Stylist provides: a publicly visible display name, a city, and optionally a phone number. The Client goes through simplified first steps (a welcome and accepting the terms).

The user is required to provide truthful information. Accounts created for abuse, spam, or breaking the terms may be suspended or deleted.

Each user can log in from several devices at the same time (multi-session). The list of active sessions is available in account settings.
registration.title: 2. Registration and Accounts

sessionShare.content:
Session Share lets a Client share selected gallery photos directly with a Stylist. The Client selects a Stylist from her list of connected Stylists and sends selected gallery photos. Sharing happens remotely, the physical presence of both parties is not required.

Shared photos appear in the Stylist's Session Clipboard and remain available for 7 days from the moment of sharing, after which they are removed automatically.

Sharing limits per hour depend on the plan: Free plan, 5 per hour, Pro and Pro Marka plans, 20 per hour, Studio plan and higher, unlimited.
sessionShare.title: 5. Session Share

staffAccounts.content:
The Staff Accounts feature is available exclusively on Studio and Scale plans. The account owner can invite people with Stylist accounts to the salon team.

An invited person can accept or decline the invitation in the app. After acceptance, their name and photo appear in the team list. Team membership does not grant access to the owner's account, gallery, client connections or inspiration sessions.

The account owner bears full responsibility for actions performed by employees through Staff Accounts. The Service Provider is not responsible for disputes between the account owner and employees.
staffAccounts.title: 7. Staff Accounts (Employee Accounts)

termination.content:
The user may close their account at any time in the app settings. After closure, the account stays restorable (recovery) for 90 days. After 90 days from closure, self-service restoration expires and the account is permanently closed. We retain data only to the extent required by legal obligations, in line with the Privacy Policy.

Within 90 days of closing the account, the user may restore it along with all data (photos, pairings, settings) by logging in again and confirming the restoration.

The user can obtain permanent erasure of their data at any time by submitting a data erasure request (Art. 17 GDPR) to privacy@nailfolio.app. We fulfill the request subject to legal obligations (for example the duty to keep billing data). Data retention rules are described in the Privacy Policy.

The Service Provider reserves the right to suspend or close a user's account in the event of terms violations, actions harmful to the Platform, or harm to other users.

reviews.consentNote: Reviews from stylists and clients who tested Nailfolio, published with their consent.
reviews.sMemory: How many times did I dig through old messages just to remember what I did for her last time. In Nailfolio I pin a gallery to each client. Before the appointment I check her history and preferences, and I already know where to start. The client memory alone is worth the subscription.
reviews.sQr: The QR code is a real winner for me. Clients hate coming up with new passwords, and here they scan the code, sign in with one tap through Google, and have my work on their phone. I show it to them right in the chair and they browse on their own. The app is light and simple. The only thing I miss is the option to add my own logo to the gallery page, to make it feel more like mine.
reviews.sTeam: I run a salon with two other girls, and before, whenever a client moved from one of us to another, we explained everything from scratch. The shared gallery and client history on the Studio plan fixed that completely. The monthly cost for a salon is really very little to me, considering that what we know about a client stays with us instead of leaving with the stylist.
reviews.sFilters: My favorite part is the smart filters. I lost count of how many times a client came in with a Pinterest photo of gel on a short nail bed, while she has long almond nails and wants exactly that. Filtering by length and technique settles it in five minutes, the client only sees what I can actually do for her. My consultations got twice as short.
reviews.sSessions: Inspiration sessions are a feature I did not know I needed, and now I do not work without them. The client gathers designs before the visit, adds notes, and I get a ready plan. No more 'maybe I will come up with something on the spot', I know what she is coming for and I have it saved in her history. Zero commission is a huge plus too, because in my previous app I used to hand over a cut of every new client. Here I pay a fixed amount and have peace of mind.
reviews.sPrice: The free plan is great to start with, to get the idea, but my client limit would run out fast. I like that this is not yet another booking calendar competing with Booksy, but something completely different, a dedicated portfolio. I recommend it, especially to beginners, so they learn good order from day one.
reviews.sAesthetic: I invest a lot in aesthetics, and it annoyed me that my best work disappeared in the Instagram algorithm, a new client only saw what the algorithm fed her. Nailfolio gives me control over what the client sees first, and my work looks much better here than in the grid. I miss the option to reorder photos by hand to put a highlight on top, but otherwise it makes a great impression.
reviews.sWeb: A useful app. I like the smart filters most, and the fact that the portfolio remembers what I did for whom, clients are surprised when I show them the QR. One thing though: I really miss a desktop version. Sometimes I prefer to arrange the gallery on a big screen rather than on my phone. It is still worth it, since you do not take a cut from clients.
reviews.cNoAccount: What I like most is that I do not have to come up with a password. I scan the code at my stylist, sign in with one tap through Google, and have her whole gallery right on my phone. I am tired of setting up accounts with yet another password to remember, and here I just open it and browse. I only miss a 'share with a friend' button to show a design to a friend, but otherwise it is great.
reviews.cMemory: I always forget what color I had three visits ago, and I lose the thread in my messages to the stylist. In Nailfolio I just go back to my history and check. No more texts like 'do you remember that beige from March?'. I recommend it to anyone who, like me, has complete chaos in her head with polish names.
reviews.cPinterest: So many times I came in with an Instagram screenshot and the lady said it could not be done on my nails. In Nailfolio I finally see only what my stylist can really do, no disappointment and no explaining that a design will not work. I can set a filter for short nails and I see right away what I will actually get.
reviews.cSessions: Inspiration sessions are the best thing I have seen. Usually before a visit I collect twenty photos on Instagram and cannot decide. Here I drop a few designs into a session, add a note like 'this base, but with these little gems', and send it to my stylist. She knows what I mean before I even walk in.
reviews.cShy: As a client I am often too shy to say in the salon that a design does not suit me. Thanks to Nailfolio I can calmly browse my stylist's work at home, pick what really fits me, and send it to her before the visit. The stress of the consultation is gone, because everything is settled in advance. I recommend it especially to the shy ones.
reviews.cTime: It cut my decision time at the salon from fifteen minutes to zero, I walk in and already know what we are doing, because I sent the inspiration session a day earlier. I like that it is free for the client and signing in through Google takes literally a moment. I would still love a reminder about an upcoming visit with a preview of the chosen inspiration, but even without it I really enjoy using it.
reviews.cInstagram: I was skeptical, but after testing I changed my mind. Browsing my stylist's work is far more convenient than on Instagram, where I cannot find anything later anyway and the algorithm keeps pushing thousands of other salons at me. Here I have a clean gallery, only her work, and I can filter by color. I love that it is cut off from social media.

story.p1: Photos chosen before a visit help you discuss color, length and nail art. When a client chooses from their stylist’s work, the conversation can refer to designs the stylist has already created.
story.p2: Social media posts help you present your work and connect with an audience. Preparing a nail design also involves photo filters, notes and the individual client’s visit history.
story.p3: Nailfolio combines these features in an app for nail stylists. Clients browse a gallery with color, style and length filters and share Inspiration Sessions after connecting with a stylist. The stylist can review the selected photos and record notes and visit history in the client card.

faq.headline: Questions clients ask most
faq.q01Answer: You can send your stylist a link to the Nailfolio page for stylists. Once they create an account and add a gallery, you can connect using their QR code.
faq.q01Question: What if my stylist isn't on Nailfolio yet?
faq.q02Answer: A stylist’s public profile is available without an account. Liking a profile requires a free client account. The full gallery and Inspiration Session sharing also require an approved connection. Sign in with Google or an email link, with no password.
faq.q02Question: Do I need to create an account?
faq.q03Answer: The Nailfolio database is hosted in the European Union. Nailfolio does not sell data to third parties or display ads. See the privacy policy for information about external services.
faq.q04Answer: After scanning the code, you send your stylist a connection request that she has to confirm. But she can't see which works you're viewing or which designs you've liked. She only sees your inspirations once you share a session with her.
faq.q04Question: Will my stylist see that I scanned the QR?
faq.q05Answer: You can connect with another stylist using their QR code. Each stylist has a separate gallery, and liked designs remain in your collection.
faq.q06Answer: Client accounts are free. No card or subscription is required.
faq.q07Answer: The fastest way is to scan the QR code at the station in the salon. You can also open your stylist's public profile from a link she sends you.
faq.q07Question: How do I find a stylist who's already on Nailfolio?
faq.q08Answer: Yes, once you're connected you can write to her in the Messages tab. If she lists a phone number on her profile, you can call too.

faq.a01: In Nailfolio, clients browse your work using color, style and length filters. They can select photos, add notes and share an Inspiration Session. Paid plans also include client history.
faq.a02: The client scans your QR code, signs in with Google or an email link and sends a connection request. Once you accept it, they can access the full gallery. The public profile with selected work is available without signing in.
faq.a03: Free has no charge or time limit. Pro includes unlimited gallery photos and connected clients, plus visit history from the last 90 days. Inspiration Sessions are available on every plan. See pricing for prices and other limits.
faq.a04: The Pro trial lasts 30 days and requires a card. Cancel in the Stripe portal before it ends to avoid a charge. Otherwise, a paid subscription starts after the trial.
faq.a05: Nailfolio is for presenting your work and preparing for visits. Booksy and Fresha offer appointment booking, which Nailfolio does not provide. You can use these tools alongside each other. <compareLink>Compare Booksy, Fresha and Instagram.</compareLink>
faq.a06: Photos remain in your account. When the paid plan ends, Free limits apply: up to 3 public profile pins, 5 photos and 2 connected clients. Above a limit, you cannot add new photos or connections. Connected clients retain gallery access.
faq.a07: The public profile with selected work is available without an account. The full gallery, QR connection and Inspiration Sessions require a free client account. Nailfolio works in a phone browser, with no installation needed.
faq.a08: Contact support before moving your gallery to discuss importing it. Available assistance depends on the format of your photos and data from the previous app.

faq.q1: When will the app be on Google Play, and how do I start today?
faq.a1: Nailfolio is available in your phone’s browser on Android and iPhone. The Android app is being prepared for publication on Google Play. A native iOS app is not currently available.
faq.a2: Clients always use it for free, with no card and no other fees. Stylists start on the Free plan, also with no card and no time limit. When they need more, they can choose Pro, Pro Marka or Studio. I price the Scale plan individually. Pro, Pro Marka and Studio come with a 30-day trial that requires a card. The subscription starts once the trial ends.
faq.q3: Does the app work without internet?
faq.a3: Features such as the gallery and Inspiration Sessions require an internet connection. Nailfolio has no offline mode.
faq.q4: Does the app collect data for advertising?
faq.a4: Nailfolio does not use marketing cookies or advertising pixels and does not share data with advertisers. You can turn off analytics in the cookie banner. The app database is stored in the EU. Information about service providers and data processing is in the privacy policy.
faq.a5: Nailfolio works straight away in the browser on any phone. The Android app (version 10 or newer) is coming to Google Play soon.
faq.q6: Does the client have to install the app?
faq.a6: Clients can use Nailfolio in their phone’s browser. An account is needed for likes and Inspiration Sessions, and a confirmed connection with the stylist gives access to the full gallery. Sign-in uses Google or an email link. The stylist’s public profile is available without an account.
faq.q7: Can I use Nailfolio as a client, without a stylist account?
faq.a7: Yes. Nailfolio lets you have two accounts at once: you can be a stylist running your portfolio and a client of another stylist. The accounts are separate, each with its own history and inspiration sessions.
faq.q8: What happens when I change my phone?
faq.a8: You sign in by email on the new device, and all your data (gallery, clients, inspiration sessions) is right there in the cloud. You can stay signed in on several devices at once, for example your phone and a tablet in the salon.

general.a1: Nailfolio is an app for nail stylists and their clients. It includes a gallery with filters, QR connections, Inspiration Sessions, Messages and a client card with visit history.
general.a2: The Free plan for stylists has no charge. Paid plans offer higher limits and additional features. Client accounts are free.
general.a3: Open nailfolio.app in your phone’s browser on Android or iPhone. Sign in with Google or a link sent by email.
general.a4: All app features are available in your phone’s browser on Android and iPhone. Nailfolio has no separate desktop app. The Android app is in preparation.
general.a5: Connections to the app are encrypted and the database is stored in the EU. Stripe handles payments. See the privacy policy for information about service providers and data processing.
general.a6: Use the contact form, email kontakt@nailfolio.app or send a message on Instagram (@nailfolio).
general.a7: Sign in with Google or a link sent by email. To receive a link, enter your email address, then open the link in the message. No password is required.
general.a8: Check your spam and promotions folders. The login link is valid for one hour; request a new one after that time. You can also sign in with Google. If the problem persists, use the contact form and provide the email address used to sign in.
general.a9: Yes. The same account works on all your devices at the same time. Sign in the same way (magic link to the same email or Google). You can check and sign out active sessions in Account → Signed-in devices.
general.a10: You can have a stylist and a client account at the same time. Go to Account → Settings → Switch role. You keep all your data, each role has its own galleries and settings.
general.a11: Close and reopen Nailfolio, then check your internet connection. If the problem persists, submit a report with your phone model, operating system and a description of the error.
general.a12: On the photo, open the menu (three dots) and choose Report, then select a reason. An admin reviews the report within 48 hours on business days and makes a decision. You'll receive a notification about the outcome.

stylists.a1: Open the app, go to the Add tab, take a photo or choose from your gallery, tag colors and features, then publish.
stylists.a2: Pinned photos are your best work, displayed at the top of your public profile. The number of pins depends on your plan.
stylists.a3: You have one permanent code: you will find it on the Connection screen, you can show it to a client on your phone or print it and hang it at your station. The client scans it with her camera, lands on your profile and sends a connection request, which you accept with one tap.
stylists.a4: The client creates an inspiration session: she picks photos from your gallery, adds notes and shares the whole collection with you in one click. You see it in the Session Clipboard in the app.
stylists.a5: Go to Account → Subscription. You can change your plan at any time: a higher plan takes effect immediately, a lower one at the end of the billing period.
stylists.a6: Studio includes a salon team roster and invitations to existing stylist accounts. An invited stylist accepts or declines the invitation. The plan covers up to 10 accounts including the owner, with no per-seat fees. Team membership does not currently provide access to the salon account or gallery.
stylists.a7: Your photos stay in your account and nothing is hidden: connected clients still see your whole gallery, and on the Free plan your public profile shows up to 3 pinned works. Free only stops you from adding photos beyond 5. Nothing is deleted without your decision.
stylists.a8: After the 30-day trial the subscription renews automatically. A reminder arrives 7 days before the charge, so you have time to cancel or change plans. You cancel from your account, no extra email needed.
stylists.a9: Go to Account → Subscription → Manage subscription. The Stripe billing portal opens, where you can cancel your subscription. After cancelling you return to the Free plan and keep your account and data. Connected clients still see all your photos, and Free only stops you from adding new ones beyond the limit.
stylists.a10: Check that your card is active and has sufficient funds. Go to Account → Subscription → Manage subscription and update your card details. Stripe will automatically retry the payment. If the problem persists, use the contact form.
stylists.a11: During the 30-day Pro trial, you can cancel without a charge. If a payment has already been taken, submit a request within 14 days. After the request is reviewed, you will receive a reply about the refund. Any approved refund is credited to your card within 5 to 10 business days.
stylists.a12: Go to Account → Team, select the staff member and click Remove. The person is removed from the salon team roster. Their private Nailfolio account remains available.

technical.a1: Nailfolio supports JPG, PNG and WEBP formats. Maximum file size is 10 MB. Photos are automatically optimised.
technical.a2: When adding a photo you choose colors from the palette available in the app. You can select multiple colors for one photo.
technical.a3: Connections to the app are encrypted. The database is stored in the European Union.
technical.a4: Features are tags describing techniques, effects and styles, e.g. French, Ombre, Chrome, Floral. The app has a set of predefined features in four categories.
technical.a5: In a stylist's gallery you filter photos by color, style and nail length. The filters combine, and results update instantly.
technical.a6: Nailfolio does not offer a public API. Submit integration questions using the contact form.
technical.a7: The gallery and Inspiration Sessions require an internet connection. Nailfolio has no offline mode.

faq.headline: The most common questions about Nailfolio next to other tools
faq.a1: No. Bookings take place outside Nailfolio. In Nailfolio, you maintain a gallery, receive Inspiration Sessions and record client history. You can add a booking link to your public profile.
faq.q2: Do I have to give up Instagram?
faq.a2: No. You can continue publishing work on Instagram and add a link to Nailfolio. In Nailfolio, clients browse a filtered gallery and choose photos for Inspiration Sessions.
faq.q3: How is Nailfolio different from Pinterest?
faq.a3: Pinterest includes photos by many creators. In Nailfolio, clients browse their stylist’s work, filter it and choose photos for Inspiration Sessions.
faq.q4: How much does it cost compared to Booksy or Fresha?
faq.a4: You start for free: 5 photos, 2 connected clients and no card. Pro is a flat monthly fee with no commission, you'll find the current price on the pricing page. Booking apps usually require a subscription, and some also take a commission on every new client acquired through their platform.
faq.q5: What can I use Nailfolio for alongside other apps?
faq.a5: In Nailfolio, you can keep your work gallery, photos chosen by clients before a visit, messages and visit history. Clients share Inspiration Sessions after connecting with a stylist.
faq.q6: Can I import photos from Instagram or Booksy?
faq.a6: Use the contact form before moving photos. You can ask for help preparing the gallery and assigning colors and features to photos.
